title.narrative: Enhancing Grenada Heritage Tourism, A Comprehensive Approach

description.narrative: The Grenada National Trust GNT proposes a transformative initiative to revitalize Grenada heritage within tourism. Through seminars led by cultural heritage specialists, licensed tour guides under the Grenada Tourism Authority will gain in depth knowledge of tangible cultural heritage. The project aims to enhance the quality of guided tours, provide official recognition through badges, and ensure accurate representation of Grenada unique heritage. Two heritage tourism seminars in September 2024 will focus on tangible heritage, customer service skills, and resource utilization. The project, aligns with Grenada vision of becoming a premier cultural destination, emphasizing sustainable and meaningful tourism.
